policy: Verifiable project work only. Implementation descriptions and observed public interfaces do not establish research findings, adoption, measured impact, operational routines, exhaustive testing, or sole authorship.
scope: All four project pages, shared project cards and metadata; related unsupported homepage counts.
dates: The displayed year is the reviewed case-study edition, not a claim about the project start or public launch. Structured data uses dateModified, not an unverified publication date.
limitations: Sibling repositories were inspected read-only; their full test suites were not run. Release status follows the owner’s confirmation. Screenshots document current public interfaces, not historical designs or research sessions. Horrorometer visual-case-study notes distinguish the signed-out live UI from the inspected local source; no authentication was completed and no review was submitted. Kanaboards captures document an unreleased local development interface with bundled sample data, not a public product or authenticated cloud workflow. Stay With Me: Deep Sea captures use the existing local web export and cover only the title, first replies and first camera recovery. Build labels are preserved; no native-device behaviour, full playthrough or player response was verified.

visualCaseStudy.flow: Signed-out public movie catalogue → Hidden title page → Write Review → sign-in page. No credentials entered or reviews submitted.
visualCaseStudy.limits: Public captures and local source inspection are distinct evidence. Exact deployed-source parity and successful post-authentication return were not verified. The inspected form has overall score, text and spoiler controls; optional API dimensions are not proof of visible form controls.

projects.visualCaseStudy: Real browser captures of the existing localhost-only development fallback and bundled sample workspace. Opened a sample card, switched to Hierarchy and expanded Unassigned; no card edits, comments, agent runs or remote workspace mutations. Sample names, comments, dates, counts and the green board indicator do not demonstrate research, adoption, delivery metrics, remote sync or completed agent execution. Start in editor copies a prompt; the separate daemon invokes runners. Product remains unreleased per owner confirmation.

removedOrCorrected: Unverified completion, ending-quality and exhaustive testing claims
Always-visible radar and native-delivery guarantees inferred from component existence
Unsupported first-person goals, playtesting outcomes, and release-hardening claims
Preserved and explained the Ocean Floor subtitle in the actual game build rather than relabelling screenshots
Distinguished authored story replies and recovered camera assets from real dialogue, footage or participant evidence
Bound browser observations to the opening sequence and first recovered camera frame, without native-delivery or complete-playthrough claims
projects.visualCaseStudy: Captured the existing 18 October 2026 local web export on 19 October. Used New Game, waited for the opening replies, selected c2 (Take a breath), waited for m-cam-galley to be revealed, then opened Tools > Camera Feed. No saved-state injection, skipped progression, generated UI or screenshot retouching. This short browser session is not a complete playthrough, native notification test or player research. Captures retain the build subtitle Ocean Floor; portfolio title remains Stay With Me: Deep Sea per owner confirmation. The story and camera imagery are fiction, not real messages or underwater footage.
